item.title: শক্তিশালী ব্যাটারি ও প্রসেসরের নতুন রেডমি ফোন বাজারে

item.title: নিষেধাজ্ঞা থাকা সত্ত্বেও জলাশয়ে ছিপ নিয়ে অবস্থান পল্টুর

item.title: দিল্লির ঐতিহাসিক মসজিদ এলাকার বাসিন্দাদের ৩১ মাইল দূরে স্থানান্তর

item.title: Telangana Minister Urges Complete Setup of Warangal Hospital Before Opening
item.description: The Health Minister of Telangana has instructed authorities to ensure all necessary equipment is installed at the Warangal Super Speciality hospital prior to its launch. This directive aims to make the medical facility fully operational for patients upon its formal opening.

item.title: Spain's Transport Minister Steps Down Following Fatal Rail Accident
item.description: Spanish Transport Minister Oscar Puente has stepped down from his position following a devastating train collision that resulted in 69 fatalities. His departure comes after two significant railway disasters occurred within a period of less than 12 months.

item.title: Indian-Origin Candidates See Mixed Outcomes in 2026 US Midterms
item.description: Indian-American politicians Suhas Subramanyam and Pia Dandiya secured victories to join the US House of Representatives in the 2026 midterm elections. Meanwhile, fellow Indian-origin candidate Vivek Ramaswamy failed to win the gubernatorial election in Ohio.

item.title: BMC Removes 27 Structures in Borivali Demolition Operation
item.description: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation has concluded a clearance drive in Mumbai's Borivali area, tearing down 27 unauthorized units. This action follows a November 3, 2026 Supreme Court ruling that suspended the civic chief's pay due to non-adherence to judicial directives.

item.title: Tamil Nadu Allocates ₹1.3 Crore to Protect Bengal Foxes and Jackals
item.description: The government of Tamil Nadu has approved a budget of ₹1.3 crore this year to evaluate threats, distribution, and habitat patterns of Bengal foxes and golden jackals. The gathered data will be utilized to formulate a long-term strategy for preserving these wild species.

item.title: Rajnath Singh stresses technological self-reliance at Delhi event
item.description: At the Delhi Defence Dialogue, India's Defence Minister stated that national self-sufficiency requires achieving technological sovereignty. He noted that building domestic arms capabilities helps cut down reliance on foreign nations.

item.title: এসকেএস ফাউন্ডেশন ৩২টি শূন্য পদে কর্মী নিয়োগের বিজ্ঞপ্তি দিয়েছে
item.description: বেসরকারি সংস্থা এসকেএস ফাউন্ডেশন ইডকলের সঙ্গে যৌথ উদ্যোগে পরিচালিত একটি সৌর প্রকল্পের জন্য বিজ্ঞপ্তি প্রকাশ করেছে। এতে রাজশাহী ও রংপুর অঞ্চলে কাজের জন্য ৩২ জন সেলস অফিসার কাম টেকনিশিয়ান নেওয়া হবে।

item.title: Poundland Vendor Faces Major Financial Loss if Chain Fails
item.description: A primary supplier warns of multi-million-pound losses should the retailer fail. Additional vendors have indicated they could face total business failure as well.

item.title: US House Speaker Johnson criticizes Marxism following Democratic win
item.description: Following a Democratic electoral victory, United States House Speaker Johnson delivered remarks criticizing Marxism. The comments came in the wake of the recent political gains made by the opposing party.

item.title: Pakistan carries out test flight of domestically built Fa'az missile
item.description: Pakistan conducted a successful test of the locally built Fa'az air-to-air missile, equipped with terminal guidance for long-range targets. Military officials witnessed the test flight, though specific speed and range details were not disclosed.

item.title: Amy Acton defeats Vivek Ramaswamy to become Ohio's first female Governor
item.description: Supported by Donald Trump, Indian-American candidate Vivek Ramaswamy was defeated in the race for Ohio Governor. Amy Acton won the election, making history as the state's initial female Governor.

item.title: Arshdeep enters top Indian pacer list after bowling out New Zealand
item.description: India restricted New Zealand to 185 runs, with Arshdeep recording the fourth-best figures for an Indian fast bowler in the country. He joins Javagal Srinath and Mohammed Shami in this exclusive statistical group.

item.title: Murasu drops to depression as heavy rainfall persists in Andhra Pradesh
item.description: The Murasu system has weakened into a depression, while coastal regions of Andhra Pradesh continue to experience heavy rains. Palnadu district's Edlapadu recorded the state's highest 24-hour rainfall at 269.45 mm.

item.title: Karnataka government announces ticket price hikes across state transport
item.description: Ticket prices have been raised across several state transport corporations, including BMTC, KSRTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC. This adjustment is smaller than the 45% hike previously suggested by the Public Transport Fare Regulatory Committee.

item.title: Delhi HC Sets Nov 6 Hearing for Attorneys' Petition Against Police Personnel
item.description: A formal petition requesting measures against a suspended ACP and police officers for alleged intimidation will be reviewed by the Delhi High Court on November 6. The judiciary previously refused to start self-initiated proceedings, directing the advocates to submit a proper application instead.

item.title: মারজুক রাসেলের উক্তি ও কৈশোরের প্রেম না হওয়া নিয়ে ব্যক্তিগত স্মৃতিচারণ
item.description: লেখক মারজুক রাসেলের প্রেম সম্পর্কিত একটি বক্তব্য উল্লেখ করে নিজের জীবনের স্মৃতি প্রকাশ করা হয়েছে। এতে বলা হয়, বয়ঃসন্ধিকালে বিপরীত লিঙ্গের প্রতি আকর্ষণ তৈরির বয়সেও বিভিন্ন কারণে রোমান্টিক বিষয় থেকে দূরত্ব বজায় রেখেছিলেন লেখক।

item.title: Musk Quips Over Republican Defeat Following Massive Campaign Funding
item.description: Following major political spending to back the Republicans, Elon Musk made light of the party's electoral loss. The Democratic Party secured majorities in both chambers of the United States Congress on November 3.

item.title: ED Inspects 11 Sites Across Kerala and Tamil Nadu in BLM Money Laundering Probe
item.description: Enforcement Directorate officials carried out searches at eleven sites across Chennai, Kozhikode, Kochi, and other areas regarding financial irregularities tied to BLM cooperative society. The operations targeted key individuals, including the society's founder and acting head R. Premkumar.

item.title: Democrats Secure Decisive Wins in Key Senate Contests
item.description: Analysis shows the Democratic Party altered the political landscape during a historic election night. Contests for two Senate seats, previously expected to be tightly contested, resulted in comfortable victories for Democratic candidates.

item.title: প্রধানমন্ত্রীর স্লোগান নিয়ে মন্তব্যের জেরে সরিয়ে দেওয়া হলো ডিটিসিএ কর্মকর্তা
item.description: ঢাকা পরিবহন সমন্বয় কর্তৃপক্ষের (ডিটিসিএ) নির্বাহী পরিচালক ও সচিব পদমর্যাদার কর্মকর্তা মোহাম্মদ মসিউর রহমানকে তার পদ থেকে অব্যাহতি দেওয়া হয়েছে। সরকারপ্রধানের একটি রাজনৈতিক স্লোগানকে হাদিসের সঙ্গে তুলনা করে বক্তব্য দেওয়ার পরই এই প্রশাসনিক পদক্ষেপ নেওয়া হয়।

item.title: Hyderabad Police Arrest Two Following Viral Footage of Assault on Females
item.description: Law enforcement officers in Meerpet, Hyderabad, registered a criminal case and detained two individuals after widespread sharing of online footage showing females being assaulted and threatened. The confrontation reportedly stemmed from accusations regarding religious conversion activities.

item.title: Democrat Troy Jackson Unseats Incumbent Republican in Maine Senate Race
item.description: Troy Jackson secured Maine's seat in the United States Senate, defeating long-standing Republican incumbent Susan Collins. The victory ended Collins' thirty-year tenure as part of a broader wave of victories for the Democratic Party.

item.title: PV Sindhu Returns to BWF World Tour Finals After Three-Year Gap
item.description: Indian shuttler PV Sindhu has secured her spot in the BWF World Tour Finals for the initial time since 2021. This marks her sixth qualification for the prestigious year-end tournament.

item.title: Kerala Chose GNA Proposal to Prevent ₹2,200 Crore Burden: CM
item.description: Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan stated that the state selected the GNA offer instead of the Himachal Pradesh arrangement to dodge heavy financial liabilities. Meanwhile, officials rejected claims connecting a KSEB leadership shuffle to energy procurement.
